title: Facts no scanner could find
label: Said by people in live run 3, 7 Nov 2026

facts.says: About 40 merchants still verify ECDSA on old SDKs
facts.without: Replacing ECDSA outright stops those merchants verifying webhooks.
facts.changed: Dual-signed: ECDSA kept beside ML-DSA-65 until 30 June 2027.

facts.says: old envelopes in the vault must stay readable
facts.without: Swapping RSA out leaves stored envelopes unreadable.
facts.changed: New envelopes hybrid; RSA kept read-only for old ones until they are resealed.

facts.says: has to stay secret for at least 7 years
facts.without: The scanner could only say "lifetime unknown: ask the engineer".
facts.changed: Ranked by Mosca's rule: already late by 1 year.

facts.says: Production TLS stays on the acquirer's edge gateway, outside our repo
facts.without: The repo fix looks done; production stays classical.
facts.changed: Staging fixed; production recorded as a signed accepted risk, with a change request.

facts.says: the acquirer's settlement client is built from this repo
facts.without: Keep a P-256 fallback for an unknown peer.
facts.changed: Both sides move to the hybrid together, with no classical fallback.

facts.says: support re-issues it as v2 from our records
facts.without: Keeping old receipts checkable means keeping SHA-1 in the code.
facts.changed: SHA-1 removed completely; old receipts are re-issued.

facts.says: our DBA re-encrypts every stored record to AES-256-GCM
facts.without: Keeping old records readable means keeping AES-128 in the code.
facts.changed: AES-256-GCM only, behind a tested gate that blocks deploy while old records remain.
